source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: As round one starts, roll D6s to build a Fate Dice pool. Roll three for Incursion, six for Strike Force or nine for Onslaught. Keep the results. When you use a listed Stratagem, you can discard one Fate Die showing its assigned face and cut the cost by 1CP. The faces in ascending order are [Presentiment of Dread](vsdata:ability/aeldari.seer-council.presentiment-of-dread), [Forewarned](vsdata:ability/aeldari.seer-council.forewarned), [Unshrouded Truth](vsdata:ability/aeldari.seer-council.unshrouded-truth), [Fate Inescapable](vsdata:ability/aeldari.seer-council.fate-inescapable), [Isha’s Fury](vsdata:ability/aeldari.seer-council.ishas-fury) and [Psychic Shield](vsdata:ability/aeldari.seer-council.psychic-shield).
